reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown and Clarke read the two claims in different domains: Jewish law could pronounce Jesus worthy of death, but only Rome could carry out an execution.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Daniel G. Taylor's BibViz Project lists the two statements side by side as a stand-alone contradiction between having no power to execute and yet declaring Jesus worthy of death.

sides.snippet: It is not lawful for us to put anyone to death
sides.verseText: Pilate therefore said to them, \"Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.\" Therefore the Jews said to him, \"It is not lawful for us to put anyone to death,\"

sides.snippet: by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.
sides.verseText: The Jews answered him, \"We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.\"
